1. Three cubes in a straight row along the bottom front.
2. One additional cube extending backward from the end of that row.

Thus the dark shape is an **L-shaped tetromino**: a row of three cubes with one cube attached at an end.

Among the choices, only **Shape B** has this arrangement. Rotating Shape B so its three-cube column becomes horizontal matches the visible dark cubes.
